name: datagoat
description: Open-source, revenue-first web analytics on Cloudflare Workers + D1. DataFast-compatible tracker, ingest and API.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-migrations.mjs && node scripts/clean-public.mjs && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:tracker
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tracker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:tracker && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:cli && npm run build && npm run size && npm run e2e

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token for the first-run setup link (`/setup?token=...`). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`. After the first owner exists it no longer works.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard session cookies. Generate a random string with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts payment-provider and integration credentials at rest (AES-GCM). Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. **Do not change it later**, or stored credentials can no longer be decrypted.

DB.description: D1 database holding all analytics, revenue and account data.

LOGIN_THROTTLE.description: KV namespace used only to throttle failed dashboard logins.
